Your holdings: SMCI (-24.89%) and SOXL (-62.47%) are really hurting. METU (-11.63%) and MUU (-35.14%) are also deep in the red, and these leveraged ETFs decay over time, amplifying your pain on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia (NVDA) as a potential safe haven in the AI trade.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech bets are under pressure; focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: Trim SMCI: The loss is significant, and the trend is down. Consider reducing exposure.
Trim SOXL: This leveraged ETF is bleeding badly. Protect capital by trimming this position.
